title: Draft scanner from goal
description: Draft a full scanner configuration from a natural-language `goal` (e.g. "find where users get stuck during onboarding"). Nothing is saved. Returns `name`, `description`, `scanner_type`, `scanner_config`, `query` and a `rationale` addressed to the person. When `monthly_credit_budget` is honored the draft also picks `sampling_mode`, `sampling_rate`, `model` and `credit_limit` to fit the budget; otherwise those come back null. Review the draft with the person, then pass it to `vision-scanners-create`. The call is an inline LLM request and can take a while.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: Goal-based flow only: credits a month to spend (1 credit = $0.01). The draft picks the `model`, then solves `sampling_mode` and `sampling_rate` so the projected spend lands on this number, and sets `credit_limit` to it as a hard cap. Omitted on the legacy flow, and ignored while the goal-based flow's flag is off for the caller.
